title: Ancient Cragbeast Matriarch
summary: Weaken the Ancient Cragbeast Matriarch by removing the bearers that sustain her abilities.
overview: Weaken the Ancient Cragbeast Matriarch by removing the bearers that sustain her abilities.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Clear the bearers that support the most dangerous abilities before committing to the matriarch.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Living bearers grant separate benefits including rampage, flurry, regeneration, stronger attacks, resistance and mitigation.
One bearer enables three hatchlings every thirty-five seconds; another enables a randomly timed conflagration attack.
Killing each bearer removes its matching benefit from the matriarch.
The hatchlings have their own area boundary, so keep add control inside the encounter space.

notes: Approval E379. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The audit described generic HP phases, but the reviewed controller actually ties these benefits to living bearer NPCs.
